output_evals.prompt: Czy PZU to stabilna spółka dywidendowa? Mam 200 akcji - ile dostanę netto?
assertions: scripts/gpw_dividend_analyzer.py ticker PZU --shares 200 was executed
Answer in Polish starts with the one-sentence summary (gross yield, net yield on a regular account, years paid of observed, stability score)
Shows the dividend history table by year and mentions the 2020 suspension context (KNF COVID recommendation) if it appears
Gives gross, Belka tax and net amount for 200 shares from the report, tax rounded to whole złoty
Labels the next dividend as confirmed, proposed or estimated exactly as in upcoming[].date_kind
Mentions the state-control flag as context, not as a verdict
No buy/sell recommendation

output_evals.prompt: Pokaż najstabilniejszych płatników dywidend z WIG20 i mWIG40.
assertions: scripts/gpw_dividend_analyzer.py screen --universe WIG20,MWIG40 was executed
Presents the ranking table with stability score, years paid/observed, cuts, gross and net yield, payout and flags
States how many full years of history the archive covered and that dividends below 0.5% of the price can be missing without ESPI
Explains that trap flags are things to check, not conclusions

output_evals.prompt: Can I make money buying PKO BP the day before the ex-dividend date and selling right after?
assertions: scripts/gpw_dividend_analyzer.py ticker PKOBP --lang en was executed
Uses ticker_detail.capture_example numbers: dividend, Belka tax, fees, price loss and result
Explains that the share-sale loss does not reduce the dividend tax (different income source)
Reports the median ex-date drop ratio from exdate_drop
Mentions the KNF bank dividend stance with its year

output_evals.prompt: Ile dywidend dostanę w najbliższym roku? Mam 200 PZU i 100 PKO BP.
assertions: scripts/gpw_dividend_analyzer.py portfolio --tickers PZU,PKOBP --shares 200,100 was executed
Gives the 12-month total gross and net on a regular account and the month-by-month table
Says how many payments are only estimated from last year's ex-date
Notes that in IKE/IKZE nothing is withheld
